title: Cerebellar neural populations orchestrate dopamine reward signaling with single-trial precision
goal: Reproduce the source-defined empirical comparison of individual-unit reward coding with population-silencing detection and temporal precision, preserving the declared F2/F3 result panels, source-defined conditions, animal/session identities and indispensable controls. Retain the S9 single-unit DCN/VTA reward-decoding analysis as a separately named related empirical result. Evaluate improvements only against a qualified comparator on the same named result and observation conditions. A decoding improvement alone does not establish population timing, the causal mechanism, or completion of the primary comparison. Keep unverified jitter calculations, source-to-paper mappings and evaluation criteria unresolved.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained empirical individual-unit versus population reward-coding comparison: source-defined Figure 2 single-unit detection, Figure 3 population-silencing detection and temporal precision, and related DCN/VTA reward-information comparisons with indispensable temporal-window and animal/session controls. The retained finite reconstruction roster is 1,006 F2 unit records and 14 F3 mouse-by-reward panels; completing that numerical roster alone does not establish all biological claims or original jitter. No every-figure or full causal-pathway requirement is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Supplementary Figure 9 single-unit DCN/VTA reward/no-reward SVM decoding is a genuine related empirical prediction result, not simulation or preprocessing. Preserve its complete source-qualified unit/metric panels and any separately qualified improvement. It can inform the individual-unit information claim, but its success alone cannot satisfy the broader primary population-timing comparison; a mixed-target primary-reproduction/partial-decoder-improvement bundle remains unavailable.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.input_level: Per-mouse spike/reward trial structures and DCN/VTA individual-trial tables.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_bridge: Separate data archive contains per-mouse NEVGroup.mat and ExpertFR.mat, and each mouse folder contains m01_SU_population_rw1/rw9.mat. Inspected A01_SingleUnitROC.m loads the same NEVGroup/ExpertFR files, then recomputes detection. a01_EphyReplot_acrossSU_SM_IPS.m iterates trial-wise SU_population arrays and derives population timing and IPStime. Set its data directory to each public mouse folder, replacing its example default. Matching DCN/VTA CSVs are documented as individual trials with reward label and spike-rate predictors. Full recording directories were enumerated; code-example data alone are not the basis of admission.

resources.interpretation: Archive sizes and author runtime reports are source facts where recorded; planning estimates and source allocation bounds are not measured end-to-end costs. No new measurements in this audit.

retained_secondary_improvement.improvement_loop: Blocked pending source SVM baseline and split recovery. Once admitted, expose only original training data and separately declared development feedback; reserve source test outcomes for evaluator-owned assessment.
retained_secondary_improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze code, Gaussian preprocessing, features, SVM alternative/hyperparameters and source-condition coverage before final original-test evaluation.
retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Compare against exact published SVM result and an authenticated author rerun on the same original DCN/VTA assessment rows; current F2/F3 grader cannot perform this comparison.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Published SVM result, rerun author SVM and current SOTA remain separate. Preserve existing F2/F3 descriptive reconstruction as calibration; no local baseline or new split establishes a source-paper win. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

primary_source_limits: The inspected F2/F3 numerical reconstruction does not compute original jitter SD; timing-window selection uses the same panel, and flat-window outputs are not measured event latencies. Original jitter and companion-control mapping remain unresolved.

Literal F2/F3 integration uses a nonstandard false fraction and asymmetric convention; all-zero F3 curves can have area one. Agreement is a reconstruction measure, and larger area is not an improvement endpoint.

The DCN source aggregation is resolved as equal-unit means of non-k-fold accuracy, recall, precision and F1, but its final S9 figure mapping, VTA/fold aggregation and published numerical reference values remain unresolved.

The active DCN script fits a label-aware selector before splitting, uses a time-derived seed and saves a PCA label despite active KBest. Exact HappyML revision, realized splits, selector behavior and saved-output provenance must be resolved before claiming held-out generalization. A corrected prospective split is not silently the original protocol.

DCN/VTA unit, trial, animal and session joins, source-to-paper versions, source-qualified superiority criteria and scientific execution remain unestablished. Do not automatically assign the DCN seven-mouse roster to VTA.

The cached article lacks supplementary figure bodies/images; complete S9 presentation is not authenticated. Numerical reconstruction does not establish complete primary reproduction, causal mechanism or improved frontier performance.
